summary: Koillection is a self-hosted web service designed for cataloguing and organising physical or digital personal collections. It provides a structured interface to keep track of items, categories, and related metadata.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want a dedicated, self-hosted system to inventory personal belongings, media, or memorabilia rather than relying on commercial spreadsheet tools.
watchOut: The project serves a niche use case and overlaps with broader personal knowledge management systems or generic database tools, which might offer more flexibility.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based PHP application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for uploaded images and user data, alongside a separate database container and a reverse proxy for HTTPS.
